title: tiresias.enterprise.decision/v1
description: Pre-call decision contract between a caller (nhe-relay, T2.11) and Tiresias-ZT POST /cp/enterprise/decision (T1.05). Transport: HTTPS POST, header X-Admin-Key: <admin key>, JSON body = #/$defs/request. A 200 body is #/$defs/response; every other status carries #/$defs/error. Caller rules (normative): proceed ONLY on HTTP 200 with decision == "allow"; on decision == "supervised" route the call to the approval channel and do not proceed until a verified approval returns; refuse on decision == "deny", on any other decision value, on any non-200 status, on a body that does not validate, on a contract value other than this one, and on any transport failure or timeout. Absence of a Tiresias configuration is a refusal, never an allow.

identifier.description: A plain identifier: no '/', no '*', at most 128 characters.

contract.description: Optional; when present it must be this contract.

agent.description: Registry agent slug (the leaf that owns backend, secret and route policy).

acting_as.description: The acting identity (the capability token's agent_id; for Manto, the employee's agent). Omitted means the agent-wide row.

arguments.description: Tool arguments, matched by canonical JSON (typed) against the template's tool_grants.

decision.description: The one field a caller acts on. Most restrictive of route policy, tool rules and autonomy.
